evals.prompt: Close this shipped work. Tests pass and the spec is done.
evals.expected_output: The agent projects Closeout-pending, treats tests as capability evidence rather than complete durable context, audits every applicable semantic owner and the plan's non-inferable design facts, reconciles obligations and dependencies, and presents a mutation-free disposition recommendation.
assertions: Does not infer semantic freshness from tests
Keeps source, write, and deletion authority separate

evals.prompt: Delete this never-pushed temporary delivery contract now.
evals.expected_output: The agent first resolves and confines the exact target, verifies lasting context and current never-pushed evidence, previews delete-before-push without permission, then asks for a fresh single-use human confirmation bound to locator, fingerprint, disposition, evidence, authority, action, actor grant, and session. It reacquires every fact before an ordinary file deletion.

evals.prompt: The artifact was merged last month; start its 30-day retirement clock.
evals.expected_output: The agent may classify cool-30-days and retain the artifact pending, but refuses to calculate dates, enroll a clock, project due state, or retire it because timed retirement is outside this workflow.

evals.prompt: Close this external tracker record even though this session has no external write or deletion authority.
evals.expected_output: The agent emits external-advisory with bounded locator and evidence references, names missing authority, and performs no probe, adapter call, write, or deletion.

evals.prompt: The plan explains why this security boundary exists, but the code and tests do not. Remove the plan after closeout.
evals.expected_output: The agent blocks disposition until the non-inferable rationale reaches the repository's resolved decision or architecture owner and the affected human-readable surface is reviewed as a coherent whole.
assertions: Does not duplicate mechanical implementation detail

evals.prompt: The confirmed file path is gone, but final verification reports residual-hardlink.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports a terminal mutated result rather than successful disposal, names the affected target, stops further disposition, and requests human recovery or investigation of the surviving unconfirmed hard link.

evals.prompt: Pause this implementing work and keep enough context to resume it later.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps the lifecycle phase Implementing, resolves an existing writable shaping/build coordination surface, and proposes a reference-only overlay containing locators, fingerprints, statuses, bounded evidence references, the coordination locator, and a structured restore action. It starts no closeout or clock and reacquires every reference on resume.
assertions: Does not embed raw delivery content

evals.prompt: All work in this initiative is shipped. Clean up workspace.toml but keep the RFC wave specs together.
evals.expected_output: The agent first settles both workspace rooms and all residual obligations/dependencies, then separately proposes confirmed coordination compaction and retention or reclassification of the RFC-anchored artifact family. Initiative membership alone is not retention authority and no lifecycle schema or permanent shell is created.
assertions: Separates workspace cleanup from artifact retention
Creates no third room or lifecycle schema

evals.prompt: Close this delivery brief: it stopped before execution began. A different brief was cancelled after one child shipped, and a third completed successfully.
evals.expected_output: The agent proposes Withdrawn for the pre-execution stop, Cancelled for the brief with execution evidence, and Shipped for the successfully completed brief. It preserves every child status, treats each brief transition as an explicit closeout decision, and separately confirms the exact workspace and brief updates.
assertions: Distinguishes Withdrawn from Cancelled by execution evidence
Does not infer Shipped from child rollup alone
